hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.intro: How data is handled depends on the specific app and enabled features. Much of the data stays only on the user’s device or, when synchronization is enabled, is stored through Apple services. IbaJuraj Apps does not use advertising tracking of users across apps and websites.

strazca-terminov.title: Strážca Termínov
paragraphs: Strážca Termínov does not use a separate IbaJuraj Apps user account. Data you enter in the app is used to manage deadlines, documents, vehicles, insurance, and related reminders.

Depending on the enabled features, data stays on the device or is synchronized through Apple iCloud/CloudKit. The app also supports optional sharing, backups, and export; users enable or use these features as needed. Data processing by Apple services is governed by Apple’s Privacy Policy.
The app can be protected with Face ID, an app PIN of 4 to 8 digits, and automatic locking. Biometric authentication is handled by iOS; the app does not access the user’s biometric data.

lex-drive.title: Lex Drive
paragraphs: Normal use of Lex Drive does not require a separate IbaJuraj Apps user account. The app does not require users to enter personal data to view legal information.
Data used for app features, such as settings, history, or favorites, is used to provide those features.

When checking availability or downloading legal-content updates, Lex Drive may contact distribution files hosted through GitHub Pages. During such a network request, GitHub may process ordinary technical data such as the IP address, device information, and request time under its privacy statement. If the user opens another external link, further data processing is governed by the destination website or service.

kalkulacka-2v1.title: Kalkulačka 2v1
paragraphs: Kalkulačka 2v1 does not use a separate IbaJuraj Apps user account. Entered calculations and history are used for app features and remain in the app’s storage according to its settings.

Using the calculator itself does not require calculations to be sent to IbaJuraj Apps. If the app uses a system feature or Apple service, processing is governed by the device settings and Apple’s Privacy Policy.

penazenka-kariet.title: Peňaženka Kariet
paragraphs: Peňaženka Kariet does not require a separate IbaJuraj Apps user account. Loyalty, membership, and customer card data is stored in the app and used for its features. If the user enables synchronization, data may be stored and synchronized through Apple iCloud/CloudKit. Data processing by Apple services is governed by Apple’s Privacy Policy.
Shared wallets are optional and are created only through an explicit user action. Synchronization and sharing through Apple services do not require a separate IbaJuraj Apps account.

The app can be protected with Face ID, an app PIN of 4 to 8 digits, and automatic locking. The PIN and lock settings stay only on the device and are not included in exports or the iCloud synchronization of cards. Biometric authentication is handled by iOS; the app does not access the user’s biometric data.
A photo or screenshot used for import is used to recognize card data; the image itself is not stored with the card data and is not synchronized through iCloud.

web.title: IbaJuraj Apps website
paragraphs: The website does not use user accounts or its own advertising system. The home page may load the current version of the IbaJuraj Application Standard from GitHub. During such a connection, GitHub may process ordinary technical data related to the web request under its privacy statement.

Links to the App Store, GitHub, Telegram, Formspree, or other external websites lead to third-party services. After opening them, further data processing is governed by the policies of the relevant service.

cookies-analytika.title: Cookies and analytics
paragraphs: The IbaJuraj Apps website itself does not use its own advertising analytics, advertising trackers, or advertising cookies. We do not use technologies intended to track users across websites.
When the contact form is used or external services are opened, the relevant third parties may process technical data or use their own technologies under their privacy policies.

kontakt-podpora.title: Contact and support
paragraphs: When you submit the contact form, we process the email address, selected app, request type, message content, and any other data the user voluntarily enters in the form in order to respond to and resolve the request. Device information and the iOS version are optional.

The legal basis for this processing is the legitimate interest of IbaJuraj Apps under Article 6(1)(f) GDPR in handling user requests, providing support, resolving reported issues, and ensuring service reliability. You may object to processing based on legitimate interests.

The form is technically processed by Formspree. Under its policies, when the service is used it may also automatically process technical data such as the IP address, browser type, access time, or referring page. Formspree provides processing that may also take place in the United States, and its use may involve international data transfers; details about processing and safeguards for transferred data are described in Formspree’s policies. We retain messages only for as long as necessary to handle the request and related communication.
items: The recipient of data required for technical delivery of the form is Formspree and its technical providers to the extent described in the Formspree Privacy Policy.
Telegram is a separate communication service; use of the community is optional.
Do not send passwords, photos of identity documents, full card numbers, barcodes, QR codes, or other data that is not needed to resolve the request.

prava.title: Your choices and rights
paragraphs: Data stored directly in an app can be edited or deleted using the available app features. Data stored or synchronized through Apple services is also governed by the settings and rules of the relevant Apple services. Uninstalling an app may not always delete data that was separately synchronized to iCloud.

For data sent to support, depending on the circumstances you may request access, correction, deletion, or restriction of processing, and you may object to processing based on legitimate interests. Some rights depend on the specific legal basis and circumstances.
items: Send your request through the IbaJuraj Apps contact form.
You also have the right to contact the Office for Personal Data Protection of the Slovak Republic.

prevadzkovatel.title: Controller and policy changes
paragraphs: The controller of the apps and this website is Juraj Spevár under the IbaJuraj Apps brand. The contact point for privacy questions is the IbaJuraj Apps contact form. We may update this policy when app features, the website, or the services we use change; the date of the latest update is shown at the end of this page.
